items.title: Meta Ads: $349.63 spend, 28 leads, $12.49 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: This run covers 2026-08-20 through 2026-08-26, a 7-day catch-up window (widened from the standard 1-day pull because the last successful meta-ads run was 2026-08-14 — see needs_attention). Meta spent $349.63 across the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 28 leads at a $12.49 average CPL, in line with the prior comparable week ($351.87 / 26 leads, $13.53 CPL). Account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged DISAPPROVED or WITH_ISSUES.

needs_attention: Gap in coverage: the last successful meta-ads run was 2026-08-14 (13 days ago), older than the 7-day lookback this agent checks. Per policy the window was widened to the maximum 7 days (2026-08-20 to 2026-08-26) rather than the standard 1-day pull. Days 2026-08-15 through 2026-08-19 have no meta-ads.json coverage and were not backfilled — the cap is 7 days per run.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads=28, offsite_search_add_meta_leads=28, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads=28 — each exactly matching the 28 counted leads, no discrepancy). This is now the second observed run with this pattern (also seen 2026-08-14) — worth reviewing whether the script's lead-action set needs extending; not hand-patched here.
